mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, admin_id, reason, starts_at, ends_at, revoked_at, revoked_by, revoke_reason, created_at FROM member_sanction WHERE id = #{sanctionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_sanction ( member_id, admin_id, reason, starts_at, ends_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{adminId}, #{reason}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_sanction SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoke_reason = #{revokeReason} WHERE id = #{sanctionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND starts_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND ( ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )

SELECT s.id AS sanctionId, s.member_id AS memberId, m.login_id AS loginId, m.display_name AS displayName, (m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS memberDeleted, s.admin_id AS adminId, a.display_name AS adminDisplayName, s.reason, AS status, s.starts_at AS startsAt, s.ends_at AS endsAt, s.revoked_at AS revokedAt, s.revoked_by AS revokedBy, r.display_name AS revokerDisplayName, s.revoke_reason AS revokeReason, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM member_sanction s INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = s.member_id INNER JOIN member a ON a.id = s.admin_id LEFT JOIN member r ON r.id = s.revoked_by WHERE s.id = #{sanctionId}
